Commentary.Commentary: That will be it from this match. The final T20I is on 6th August in Guyana. Do join us at 1030 local (1430 GMT) for all the action. Until then, it's goodbye and cheers!

Victorious Indian skipper, Virat Kohli says that they had a really clinical game today. Feels the wicket was always going to be best at the start and reckons it was a good finish by Krunal and Jadeja. Adds that it slowed down towards the end but he's glad that they got to 160-plus. He is happy with the way they bowled. Further says that winning the first two games gives them the chance to try out new players. Mentions that winning is always a priority and they want to play expressive cricket. States that closing the series with one game to go gives them a cushion but they are not going to take the last game lightly. Kohli is all praise for Washington Sundar. Lauds him for showing composure in the Powerplay and tells that he is handy with the bat as well. Further says that he is executing his plans really well and is looking quite lean and fit. Tells that he is expecting a big crowd in Guyana where he hasn't played before and he is looking forward to the experience.

KRUNAL PANDYA IS THE MAN OF THE MATCH! Says that it has been good two games for them and it's a different experience playing here in the USA. (On batting down the order) Pandya replies that he has been doing that for his team in the Indian T20 League or wherever he plays. Feels it's important to be in a good frame of mind and is happy with the way he bowled. Adds that both the trades go together, as batting helps his bowling and vice versa. On his bowling plans, Krunal tells that he was trying to bowl outside the off stump as the wicket was double-paced with some balls sticking and some skidding.

After a long wait, we are ready for the presentation. Carlos Brathwaite comes up first! Starts by saying that they didn't get the start they wanted with the ball but pulled things back really well. Feels that they had a solid platform and would have given a real shot at the end although it was a difficult task. Praises Rovman Powell for his knock and tells that there was a little bit of improvement in their batting from yesterday. Adds that the plan was to send Pollard later to finish the game. Wants the batting order to be flexible and batting wise it's really close to where they want it to be. States that consistency from his side is what he is looking for.

The Men in Blue were brilliant with the ball in the Powerplay. Washington Sundar was excellent in his spell of three overs along with Bhuvneshwar Kumar. Khaleel Ahmed and Navdeep Saini proved to be expensive today but it's not as if they bowled too badly. With the series already in the bag, we might see India trying out the other players in their squad in the final T20I.

In reply, the hosts once again faltered with the bat at the start. The move to send Sunil Narine flopped as rather than giving a quickfire start, he consumed too many balls. After losing two wickets cheaply, Nicholas Pooran and Rovman Powell put together a 76-run stand to do the recovery job. Pooran, though, was very slow in his knock and as a result, the asking rate kept on mounting. The 14th over bowled by Krunal where he nipped out both the set batsmen threw the home team in a precarious situation and then the rain came to deny the likes of Kieron Pollard and Shimron Hetmyer a shot at the target.

Right then, INDIA WIN BY 22 RUNS (DLS method) to take an unassailable lead in the 3-match series. It was a much better batting performance by India although the middle order still needs to find a way to score runs. Powered by the contributions from the top three and a late cameo by Krunal Pandya, India posted a daunting target in front of West Indies on a sluggish surface.
Update 1423 local - Play has been officially CALLED OFF! The conditions only got worse and it started to rain heavily leaving the umpires with no option but to end it.
Update 1400 local - It has started to rain now! It looks doubtful that we will have any more play in this match. Let's wait and hope for the best.

Update 1337 local - What's happening there? The covers are coming on and the players are leaving the field. It's not raining yet. We are hearing that it's a precautionary measure as there is a warning for lightning. It's quite windy at the moment. The DLS par score at this stage is 120 and West Indies are well behind. Let's hope that the players will be back on the ground soon.
Hangs back and punches it to extra cover. It spins past Saini inside the ring and the batsmen take two.
Shortish and on off, it's chipped over covers for one.
Play and a miss! Shortish and wide outside off, Hetmyer tries to cut but misses.
Flatter on middle, helped to mid-wicket. Dot to end the over.

DROPPED BY KOHLI! A long hop on middle, Hetmyer pulls it in the air at mid-wicket and Kohli dives to his left inside the ring. He gets it in his grasp but fails to hang on. A single is taken. Will this cost India?

Aerial but safe! This one stops a bit onto the batsman after landing around off, Pollard is early into the shot and ends up pushing it back uppishly. Jadeja dives across to his left but it goes under his left hand and the batsmen take a run.
Nearly a drag on! Flatter delivery, short and on off, Pollard tries whipping across the line but gets a bottom edge. It goes on one bounce to the keeper.
FOUR! Powered away! Flatter one, on middle, Pollard lines up the delivery and hammers it over the bowler's head for a boundary at long on.
Quicker one, short and on off, Pollard punches it back to the off side and Jadeja runs to make the stop.
Ravindra Jadeja, finally, is unleashed into the attack. Also, it has gone very dark out there. Angry clouds staring down at the stadium.
FOUR! Slapped away! Short in length and wide outside off, enough room there for Hetmyer to whack it through backward point for a boundary. Outstanding over by Krunal, 6 runs and 2 wickets from it.
Shimron Hetmyer walks in next at number 6.

OUT! That's hitting the stumps and Krunal Pandya has turned this chase completely in India's favour. Both the set batsmen are back in the hut leaving West Indies in a precarious situation. Pandya dishes out an arm ball on middle and it skids on to ping Powell on the front pad as he fails to play it out. They appeal and the finger has gone up. Rovman takes the referral but it's of no use. The Hawk Eye shows that it has hit him in line and is going on to destroy the stumps.
Shout for an lbw! Given. That looks plumb but Rovman Powell wants to review it.
Pollard has played it towards mid-wicket. They pick up a single.
Flatter and on off, defended from the back foot.
Kieron Pollard arrives.

OUT! Excellent catch by Manish Pandey, lovely piece of athleticism by him. Pandya delivers it flat and a touch short around off, Pooran fetches it from there and tries to pump it over long on. But he gets more height than distance on his shot. Pandey settles himself near the rope to catch the ball and then tosses it up as he crosses the fence. He then returns to catch it again. An uncharacteristic knock by Nicholas is over, bringing an end to a 76-run stand. 84 needed more off 40 balls.
Slower one, skidding down, Pooran tries to play the reverse sweep but misses. It hits him on the body.
Wide! Krunal sees the movement from the batsman and bowls it wide outside off. But it's way wide outside off and called a wide.
A slower one on the last ball and it deceives the batsman. Rovman is very early into his shot and misses. 85 needed off 42 balls.
Superb delivery. Nothing from the Free Hit! Saini spears in a full ball around leg, Powell stays back to hammer it across the line but misses. It goes right through his legs to the keeper.
Free Hit coming up...

FOUR! Bang! Saini delivers it on a length around off, Powell throws all his power behind this shot and thwacks it past the mid off fielder for a boundary. That's not all, it has been given as a no ball because there were only three fielders inside the circle.
Short in length and on middle, Pooran pulls it down to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Swing and a miss! Width on offer outside off, Pooran tries smashing it over the off side but misses.

Second T20I fifty for Rovman Powell and it has come in good time! A slower delivery, shortish and on off, Powell works it with gentle hands through mid-wicket and runs the first run hard. But that's all he will get. A fine knock by him so far. 91 needed more for West Indies!
Driven towards the mid off region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Navdeep Saini is back on. 2-0-19-0, so far. The young man has been expensive today.
SIX! This one has gone all the way to spoil a good over. Slightly short and on off, Powell picks it early, goes back deep inside the crease and muscles it over mid-wicket.
Fires it in outside off, Powell digs it out towards backward point. Dot.
Darts in a yorker on off, Rovman digs it out back to the bowler.

Short and wide outside off, Pooran slaps it through the line and Kohli chases it from the circle before putting in a dive to make the half stop. Only one taken. Brilliantly done by the Indian skipper, leading from the front.
Quicker and on middle, Rovman works it through mid-wicket and Krunal himself runs after it. Only a run.
Played to the point region by the batsman. No run.
Wide! Well, that's a bit harsh. A full toss outside off, just inside the tramline, the batsman leaves and Pant catches it on the full. Rishabh is not happy with the call from the umpire, rightly so.
Fullish and close to off, Powell plays it near his front pad and pushes it towards extra cover for one. Good last two overs for India.
Angling into the batsman, Pooran closes the face of his bat and helps it towards wide mid on for one.
Slower again, on a length around off, Pooran winds up for a big shot but gets an inside edge onto the pads.

Uppish but just out of the reach of the fielder! Back of a length ball on off, a slower one, Powell camps back to power it over mid-wicket but it takes the outer half of his bat and flies towards extra cover. Kohli moves swiftly across to his left, puts in a dive but it lands just short of his outstretched hands. A single taken.
Wide! Back of a length ball down the leg side, Powell tries to glance but misses.
On a length around off, Powell pushes it out with an angled bat to point.
Good length ball on off, angling away, it's the slower one, Powell tries playing late but misses.
Khaleel Ahmed is back on.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman. One run added to the total. 62/2 at the halfway mark, 106 needed more.
Fullish and outside off, skidding on with the angle, Rovman tries to drive but misses.
Shortish and on off, Powell moves back and works it with soft hands through wide mid on. Easy two there.
Bat on ball this time and Pooran punches it to sweeper cover for one.
Play and a miss! Short in length and outside off, Powell tries to cut but misses.
Flatter one on middle, helped towards square leg for a run. 50-run stand comes up!
Bowling change. Krunal Pandya is into the attack now.

Well stopped, Krunal! Quicker one, flat and on the pads, Pooran whips it behind square leg. It races away and Krunal does well in the deep to stop it with a full length dive. Saves two for his team. 11, 10, 11 - Runs coming from the last three overs.
Aerial but safe! Floated full ball around off, Powell advances down the track for a big shot but fails to middle his shot. It takes the outer half and flies over point for a run.
Shortish and on off, Pooran moves back inside the crease and strokes it to sweeper cover for a run.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Quicker and flatter on off, Powell goes back and plays it down to the right of short third man for a run.
SIX! Dismissed! Loopy delivery, landing full on middle, Powell sits down on one knee and slog sweeps it massively over backward square leg for a biggie. 50 comes up for West Indies.
Washington Sundar is back into the attack.

Shortish and on off, Pooran pulls it across the line but finds the mid-wicket fielder. 10 from the over, 21 in the last two, this pair is trying to revive the West Indian chase. The stand moves to 38 off 30 balls of which Powell has contributed 28. 122 needed off 72 balls.
The batsman guides it to third man. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Streaky again! No justice for bowlers. Saini darts in a length ball on off, Powell stays back and tries to defend late but it takes the outside edge and flies past the keeper for a boundary.

EDGY FOUR! Not where Powell intended to hit by any stretch of imagination. The extra pace of Saini brought that inside edge but he's still unlucky to concede a boundary. He spears in a length ball on middle, Powell tries to whip it over mid-wicket but it takes the inside edge, misses the stumps and races away to the fine leg fence.
Back of a length ball on off, angling in, Rovman covers the line and defends it back.
Good length ball on off, Nicholas punches it through covers for a run.
FOUR! Boom! Khaleel overpitches again, around off, Powell latches onto it and smacks it over wide mid off for a boundary. 11 from the over and West Indies will hope that this breaks the shackles.
Shortish and on off, Powell attempts to hook but misses.
Fullish and on off, Powell pushes it with an angled bat towards point and wants to steal a run right under Jadeja's nose. That ain't possible. Pooran immediately turns down the single.
SIX! Rovman Powell is a real delight to watch when in full throttle. Ahmed lands it full and around off, Rovman gives it the full whack of his bat and sends it packing over long off.
Streaky! Fractionally short and outside off, Pooran throws his bat at it and the ball runs off the outside edge down to third man for a run.
Good length ball close to the off stump line, Pooran punches it down but finds mid off.

FOUR! Well timed and placed! Short in length and on middle, Powell is on top of the delivery and pulls it through backward square leg. It speeds away and the fine leg fielder stands no chance of cutting it off. 25/2 in Powerplay, India have set the tone in this run chase and West Indies are running behind.
Extra bounce from a good length around off, Powell eventually does well to keep it out safely towards cover-point.
Too full in length on off, Powell gets behind the line and drives it down to mid on.
Good length ball on middle and off, Pooran stays back and taps it down with an angled bat through backward point for one.

FOUR! Shades of Yuvraj Singh on that shot! A touch short in length around leg, Pooran moves back, lifts his front leg in the air and then spanks it through backward square leg. Plenty of bottom hand and it races away to the fence.
Starts with a length ball on off, Pooran gets forward and pushes it down to mid off.
Navdeep Saini, the star with the ball on his debut on Saturday, is introduced into the attack.

Direct hit would have been tight! Fullish and on off, Pooran bunts it down to mid off and races across to the other end. Sundar takes aim at the bowler's end but misses. Had he hit, it would have been very close.
Fractionally short in length on off, Pooran punches it from the back foot but finds the cover-point fielder.
In the channel outside off, some extra bounce there, Nicholas leaves it well in the end.
Slower one, on a length around off, Powell plays it late towards short third man and crosses.

FOUR! This one is nailed down the ground! Khaleel delivers it full and around off, slower in pace, Powell presents the full face of his bat and smashes it straight back past his partner for a boundary at long off.
Good length ball on off, Pooran taps it down towards point and steals a quick run.
Khaleel Ahmed is the first bowling change.
Pitches it up and outside off, Pooran reaches out for it and drives it towards long off for a run. 9/2 in 4 overs, a brilliant start from India!
Good length ball on middle and off, Nicholas defends it back.
The line is quite straight from Bhuvi, Pooran works it around but finds the fielder at mid-wicket.
Angling away from the batsman, Pooran flashes at it and misses.
A length ball on off, angling away, Pooran tries to push it through the line but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Fuller in length on middle, worked on the leg side but straight to mid-wicket.
Rovman Powell is promoted up the order.

OUT! Bowled 'em! The pressure was mounting on Narine after so many dots and that has brought his downfall. Sundar sends it flatter through the air and lands it on middle, it skids on after pitching as Narine gives the charge. He swings his bat but fails to meet the ball and it goes through to rattle the stumps. The move to open with Narine has not worked as he departs for a 12-ball 4.
Skidding into the batsman from middle and leg, Narine tries to swing but misses and takes a blow on his thigh pad.
Short and outside off, Narine packs a punch but fails to beat the extra cover fielder. Sundar has been lucky so far.
Sliding down the leg side, Pooran goes back to work it away but misses. It takes his pads before rolling behind the wickets. The batsmen take a leg bye.
Pitches it up and outside off, Pooran drives through the line but straight to point on this occasion.
Shortish and on middle, Pooran gets back to pull but finds the square leg fielder with his shot.
Shortish and on off, Narine smashes it past mid off and takes a couple of runs. 6 from the over, India have started well here.
Edged but safe! Width on offer outside off, Narine throws his bat at it and gets a top edge. It falls safely in no man's land at third man as the fielders from the ring go after it. Two taken.
A full toss on off, Narine drives but finds the cover fielder.
On middle and leg, Pooran eases it through square leg for a run.
Nicholas Pooran is the number 3 batsman.

OUT! That's a clean catch by Kumar and Lewis departs cheaply once again. A delivery landing on a length around off, it stops a bit onto the batsman who tries to defend from the crease. But it takes the upper half of his bat and loops back towards the bowler. Kumar dives across to his right to claim the catch. The umpires get together and take it upstairs to check whether it's taken cleanly or not. Meanwhile, Lewis is seen walking back. The replays confirm that Kumar has done an amazing job and India draw first blood.
OUT! Excellent caught and bowled by Bhuvneshwar Kumar! The umpires though want to check whether it's cleanly taken or not.

Wide! Kumar slips a length ball down the leg side, Evin attempts to flick but misses. Pant dives across to his right to collect the ball. Fumbles a bit but no run taken. Bhuvi is not too impressed with the wide call from the umpire.
Starts with a length ball close to off, Lewis is behind the line as he pushes it down to mid off.
Bhuvneshwar Kumar to bowl from the other end.
Shorter and outside off, Narine cuts from the back foot again but finds the point fielder. Tidy start from Sundar, just one wide off it!
Swing and a miss! Loopy and wide outside off, going straight on, Narine tries heaving it over the leg side but misses.
Quicker, flatter and shorter on off, Narine connects with his back foot punch but finds the extra cover fielder.
Some turn there. Flighted and around off, turning away, Narine tries to play late from the back foot but misses.
Again the length is on the shorter side outside off, Sunil goes back to punch but mistimes it back to the bowler.
Wide! Slightly quicker through the air this time, it's short and wide outside off, Narine swishes and misses.
A flatter delivery, landing close to off, Narine gets forward and pushes it towards cover-point.

Time for the run chase! Evin Lewis and Sunil Narine, playing his 50th T20I, are the openers for West Indies. India, like yesterday, are starting with the spin of Washington Sundar. All set, here we go...
